title: General in an Apron  (围裙将军)

segments.t: 星期三早上六点，温暖的晨光洒满厨房。泰莎舒服地坐着，脚踝垫在两个枕头上，像指挥家挥舞指挥棒一样敲着木勺，指挥着欧文揉面团，以及汉娜熬制柠檬酱。先完整听一遍吧。
Push with the heel of your hand, Owen, fold once, quarter turn, push again!
Yes, Chef! How does the dough look now?
Smooth, soft, and springing right back. Into the warm bowl under a damp cloth!
Four egg yolks, fresh lemon juice, and three spoons from the sugar jar, Tessa!
Keep whisking over gentle heat, Hannah. Never let the bottom boil!
How is your ankle feeling this morning, Tessa?
Honestly? Half the swelling is gone already because you two kept me off my feet!
Look how thick and glossy the yellow lemon curd just turned!
Off the flame immediately! Stir in one cold cube of unsalted butter!
Smell that bright lemon steam filling the whole first floor!
Twenty crisp almond tart shells ready on the cooling tray!
Not bad at all, apprentices. My bakery is in safe hands!
接下来，让我们仔细学学这些厨房里的生动表达。
Push with the heel of your hand, Owen, fold once, quarter turn, push again!
「用手掌根部推，欧文，折叠一次，转四分之一圈，再推！」 英语里的面包师用这个词组来称呼手掌肉厚的那部分，
the heel of your hand
字面意思就是“手的脚跟”。
Yes, Chef! How does the dough look now?
「是，主厨！现在面团看起来怎么样？」 注意英语里的不发音字母：在
the dough
这个词里，结尾的 -gh 完全不发音，整个词和 go 押韵。
Smooth, soft, and springing right back. Into the warm bowl under a damp cloth!
「光滑、柔软，而且一按就回弹。放进温暖的碗里，盖上湿布！」 当揉好的面团按下去能迅速弹回原状时，就可以用这个短语来形容，
springing right back
其中的 spring 生动地传达了像弹簧一样的弹性。
Four egg yolks, fresh lemon juice, and three spoons from the sugar jar, Tessa!
「四个蛋黄、新鲜柠檬汁，再从糖罐里舀三勺糖，泰莎！」 鸡蛋的蛋黄有一个专门的词，里面的字母 l 是不发音的：
egg yolks
它读作 /joʊks/，和 oaks 押韵。
Keep whisking over gentle heat, Hannah. Never let the bottom boil!
「保持在文火上不断搅拌，汉娜。千万别让底部沸腾！」 动词 keep 后面加上 -ing 形式，表示动作持续不断，
Keep whisking
意思是“不要停止用搅拌器搅拌”。
How is your ankle feeling this morning, Tessa?
「你今天早上脚踝感觉怎么样，泰莎？」 想要关切地询问别人的伤势恢复得如何，这种表达非常自然，
How is your ankle feeling
好像脚踝自己能回答感觉怎么样似的。
Honestly? Half the swelling is gone already because you two kept me off my feet!
「说实话吗？一半的肿胀已经消退了，因为你们俩不让我下地走路！」 乖乖坐着休息，不走路也不站立，可以用这个短语来概括，
kept me off my feet
字面意思就是“让我远离了我的双脚”。
Look how thick and glossy the yellow lemon curd just turned!
「看这黄色的柠檬酱刚变得多么浓稠光亮！」 在描述质地或颜色的形容词前面，使用这个表示变化的动词，
just turned
表达了柠檬酱刚刚呈现出那种丝滑的光泽。
Off the flame immediately! Stir in one cold cube of unsalted butter!
「马上离开火源！搅拌加入一块无盐的冷黄油！」 介词 in 加在 stir 后面，把普通的“搅拌”变成了“搅拌并融入”，
Stir in
这是把冷黄油融入热酱汁里的经典动作。
Smell that bright lemon steam filling the whole first floor!
「闻闻那充满整个一楼的明亮的柠檬热气！」 永远记住这个美国文化中的小细节：
the whole first floor
指的是街道那一层，在其他一些国家通常被称为底层（ground floor）。
Twenty crisp almond tart shells ready on the cooling tray!
「冷却盘上已经准备好了二十个酥脆的杏仁挞皮！」 已经烤好、等着填入馅料的酥皮底，在糕点制作中被称为
tart shells
形象地把它们比作薄薄的金黄色的贝壳。
Not bad at all, apprentices. My bakery is in safe hands!
「相当不错，学徒们。我的面包房交到你们手里很安全！」 和我们的表达几乎一模一样，只是多了一个形容词 safe（安全的），这个短语
in safe hands
肯定了工作坊得到了最好的照料。现在，用自然语速把整个场景再听一遍吧。
Push with the heel of your hand, Owen, fold once, quarter turn, push again!
Yes, Chef! How does the dough look now?
Smooth, soft, and springing right back. Into the warm bowl under a damp cloth!
Four egg yolks, fresh lemon juice, and three spoons from the sugar jar, Tessa!
Keep whisking over gentle heat, Hannah. Never let the bottom boil!
How is your ankle feeling this morning, Tessa?
Honestly? Half the swelling is gone already because you two kept me off my feet!
Look how thick and glossy the yellow lemon curd just turned!
Off the flame immediately! Stir in one cold cube of unsalted butter!
Smell that bright lemon steam filling the whole first floor!
Twenty crisp almond tart shells ready on the cooling tray!
Not bad at all, apprentices. My bakery is in safe hands!
在主厨泰莎的注视下，面包面团慢慢发酵，二十个金黄的挞皮里装满了光泽诱人的柠檬酱。我们下个场景见！
See you soon!
